description: Read messages, guilds, channels and user profiles, search messages, send messages and manage your reactions on discord.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Discord session.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a Discord channel with optional pagination (pass at most one of before/after/around). Uses the logged-in session of the current discord.com tab.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Discord channel in the logged-in discord.com tab, optionally replying to a message ID. Posts through the channel messages endpoint of your own session.

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Discord message. Accepts Unicode emoji or custom emoji in name:id form.

tools.name: remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove your own emoji reaction from a Discord message. Accepts Unicode emoji or custom emoji in name:id form.

tools.name: list_guilds
tools.description: List the Discord guilds (servers) your logged-in account belongs to, with approximate member counts.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List the channels of a Discord guild (server): id, type, name, topic, position, parent category and NSFW flag.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Read a Discord user profile by user ID, or pass '@me' for the logged-in account.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search messages in a Discord guild by content with optional author, channel and attachment filters. Results come grouped by context.
